subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): onModelDiagnosticEvent for trusted model.* events

question: Should OpenClaw accept `onModelDiagnosticEvent` as a public observability-focused plugin SDK seam for trusted model diagnostics, rather than waiting for or replacing it with a provider-scoped usage feed?
rationale: This creates a new public plugin SDK compatibility contract, and adjacent provider-scoped usage work was explored but is not a merged canonical replacement.

options.title: Accept narrow diagnostic seam
options.body: Proceed after the surface-budget repair, keeping the listener scoped to trusted model diagnostics and documented as observability-only.

options.title: Defer to provider-scoped usage
options.body: Pause or close this PR and revive a provider-owned usage feed if diagnostics should not be the accounting seam.

options.title: Request a different API shape
options.body: Keep the underlying problem open but ask for different naming or event boundaries before adding a public export.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow diagnostic seam
recommendation.body: Proceed after the surface-budget repair, keeping the listener scoped to trusted model diagnostics and documented as observability-only.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on the diagnostic-runtime SDK seam and recent plugin SDK surface-budget ownership.
